206-2023-4289-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2438-5254-6774.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2438-5254-6774.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

4186-5445-6495.easyPrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-6495.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-5445-6495.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Squirrel.
When the Squirrel dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
4186-5445-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-6495-6972.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1726-6495-6972.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

757-5087-5101-5524.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-5087-5101-5524.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Merfolk Skydiver to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Destiny Spinner, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1671-5411-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6774-7811.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Loading Zone
Repeat.

2324-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4050-5319-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
4050-5319-6972.notes: If Geralf's Messenger starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

1661-5078-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Repeat

1394-1887-2060-4050-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Vorinclex.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Vorinclex.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

4907-6747-6798-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4907-6747-6798-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

1308-1651-3340-6871.description:
Activate Bootleggers' Stash by tapping it, as it's a land due to Toph, creating two Treasure tokens due to Anointed Procession.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Bootleggers' Stash.
Repeat.

3490-3597-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {R}.
Juri triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
3490-3597-5231.notes: You can sacrifice Juri to deal infinite damage to any target once you stop the loop.

1183-2364-4853.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Mana Vault.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
1183-2364-4853.notes: Once you have enough mana, you can untap other artifacts using Dross Scorpion

261-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1247-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that share a creature type.
1247-3918-7013.description:
Activate Trazyn using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

850-1379-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1379-1978.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3518-4195-4574-5243.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

2173-2292-4063-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Fleshtaker trigger.
Resolve the Fleshtaker trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2961-5147-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2961-5147-6553.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

478-1671-2821-3664-3918.notablePrerequisites: Trazyn does not have summoning sickness.
478-1671-2821-3664-3918.description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Minamo, Lotus Field and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Trazyn.
Repeat from step 3.

803-2034-5853.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
803-2034-5853.notablePrerequisites: Arcane Adaptation on the battlefield with "Rat" chosen.
803-2034-5853.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Snail, adding {C}{C}.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Arcane Adaptation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

3057-4875-5703.notablePrerequisites:
"Assassin" chosen with  Conspiracy.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have a way to give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance.
3057-4875-5703.description:
Give Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad vigilance by any method.
Declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling Bloodthirster from your graveyard with a memory counter on it as it is an Assassin due to Conspiracy, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the Bloodthirster token.
The Bloodthirster token triggers, causing you to untap it and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, exiling the Bloodthirster token.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad as an attacker.
Altaïr Ibn-La'Ahad triggers, creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each creature you own in exile with a memory counter on it.
Repeat from step 4.

1809-2104-2665.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Returned Pastcaller.
1809-2104-2665.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Returned Pastcaller.
When the token Returned Pastcaller enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2060-2577-3602-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
2060-2577-3602-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {R}.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

803-4385-4659-5331.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {2}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
When the Sliver enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Treasure, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

234-411-3309-4452.description:
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Merrow Reejerey triggers, untapping Twinning Glass.
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it to your hand from the battlefield, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Activate Twinning Glass by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to cast Grinning Ignus without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

262-4762-5303.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery and Sigil of the Nayan Gods attached to Devoted Druid.
Devoted Druid does not have summoning sickness and has a power of one or greater.
262-4762-5303.description:
Activate Devoted Druid by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

339-1656-3360.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
339-1656-3360.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Jegantha's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Torchling's ability by paying {R}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat.

914-1170-1309-3130-4074.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
You have not copied a spell using Chandra this turn.
914-1170-1309-3130-4074.description:
Cast Blue Sun's Twilight by paying {5}{U}{U}, targeting Salvager of Secrets.
Chandra and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Chandra.
Resolve the Chandra trigger, creating a copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Resolve the copy of Blue Sun's Twilight, creating a token copy of Dockside Extortionist.
The Dockside Extortionist token enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Resolve the original Blue Sun's Twilight from step 1, creating a token copy of Salvager of Secrets.
The Salvager of Secrets token enters the battlefield, returning Blue Sun's Twilight from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{U}{U}.
Activate Chandra's third loyalty ability by removing four loyalty counters from it, dealing four damage to up to two targets.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead target Salvager of Secrets and any other creature to get infinite copies of any creature on the battlefield.

915-3807-5116.notablePrerequisites: Swift Reconfiguration attached to Synod Artificer.
915-3807-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping itself and Gilded Lotus.
Repeat.

1446-3253-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Myojin of Blooming Dawn has at least one indestructible counter on it.
You control at least two other permanents.
1446-3253-4050.description:
Activate Viral Drake by paying {3}{U}, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin.
Activate Myojin by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing four Spirit tokens, adding {U} and three mana of any color.
Repeat.

776-1329-2709-4370.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-2709-4370.description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Darksteel Relic to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Darksteel Relic.
Cast Darksteel Relic.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1929-2428-3957.notablePrerequisites:
Oracle's Insight attached to Famished Paladin.
Famished Paladin does not have summoning sickness.
1929-2428-3957.description:
Tap Famished Paladin to draw a card.
When you draw a card, Horizon Chimera will trigger, gaining you 1 life.
Gaining the life untaps Famished Paladin.
Repeat.

1182-2882-4675.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
1182-2882-4675.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Stonecoil Serpent from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
